What it does: How far one horse strays from its breed's leanings, on the -2 to +2 trait scale (standard deviation). Bigger = more varied horses.
How far a good horse sits on the good side of its breed, and a bad horse on the bad side, before the spread.
A trait this far on the wrong side of the breed counts as a flaw. A good horse keeps at most one flaw, a bad horse at most one good trait.
Chance a horse gets 2 quirks instead of 1.
How many times more often a breed's likely quirks are picked than other quirks.
How far natural stats spread, in ranks (standard deviation). Each stat rounds to a whole rank: 0.6 gives mostly 0, often 1, rarely 2.
How far good horses' natural stats lean up and bad horses' lean down, in ranks.
Wild horses: Temper minus Bond affinity at or above this breaks Hard.
Wild horses: at or above this, a horse is Unbreakable if it also wins the UnbreakableChance roll; otherwise Hard.
Bond XP rate for a good (not prized) horse on the climb from bond level 3 to 4. 0.75 = takes a third longer. Levels 1-3 are normal. Proposed; tune in Phase 6.
Bond XP rate for a prized horse (stable-bought, special, rare, community favorite) from bond 3 to 4. 0.5 = takes twice as long. Levels 1-3 are normal. Proposed.
Added to a prized wild horse's Temper minus Bond affinity, so it breaks Hard more often. Prized horses are never Unbreakable. Proposed.
Bond level at which the first rank of a health or stamina difference shows on the stat bars.
Bond level at which a second rank of difference shows (only a -2 horse has one).
